subunit: Soluble monomer. Homotetramer. A dynamic intracellular population of tetramers and monomers coexists normally and the tetramer plays an essential role in maintaining homeostasis. Interacts with UCHL1. Interacts with phospholipase D and histones. Interacts (via N-terminus) with synphilin-1/SNCAIP; this interaction promotes formation of SNCA inclusions in the cytoplasm. Interacts with CALM1. Interacts with STXBP1; this interaction controls SNCA self-replicating aggregation. Interacts with SNARE components VAMP2 and SNAP25; these interactions allows SNARE complex assembly and integrity. Interacts with RPH3A and RAB3A. Interacts with SERF1A; this interaction promotes the aggregation of SNCA. Interacts with SEPTIN4. Interacts with DDX10; this interaction causes DDX10 mislocalization to the nucleoplasm and cytoplasmic inclusions
